zones.name: South Waterfront Piers & Patrol Boat Dock
zones.description: Player Start Position at (800, 10) on the eastern concrete breakwater; Pier Berth at (90, 30) where Enemy Patrol Boat (veh_boat_patrol_a) is moored (S2 — plant tracker on hull), and West Dock Extraction at (60, 40) (radius 10.0m); guarded by Environmental Hazards M07_T16_01 and M07_T16_02 along wet pier power conduits.

zones.name: Main Shipping Container Maze
zones.description: Dense multi-lane yard of stacked 20ft/40ft containers (prop_container_20ft, prop_container_40ft), forklifts (veh_forklift_industrial_a), and 4 Security Cameras (M07_CAM_01 to M07_CAM_04), guarded by Tripwire Alarms M07_T1_01 (255, 150) & M07_T1_02 (480, 210), patrolled by E2 Grunts, E3 Officers, and E10 Scouts.

zones.name: East Gantry Crane & Cargo Loading Apron
zones.description: Dominated by towering Gantry Crane (env_crane_gantry_a) at (700, 150) with rotating floodlight sweeping the yard every 90s (E_M07_CRANE), Sniper M07_E6_01 perched on upper catwalk, and Crane Control Booth at (700, 150) (S1 — sabotage crane controls).

zones.name: 3-Story Harbor Administration & Top-Floor Vault
zones.description: Handcrafted 3-floor brick-and-concrete headquarters (floors: 3, entries via front lobby, back service stairs, roof access, and vent shafts env_vent_shaft_2m): Floor 1 (Lobby, Alarmed Doors M07_T13_01 & M07_T13_02, Cameras M07_CAM_05 & 06, Alarm M07_ALM_01), Floor 2 (Server & Camera Control M07_MON_01, Pressure Plates M07_T7_01 & 02, E9 Technicians), Floor 3 (Executive Vault Suite at (410, 470) for O1 guarded by 4x E4 Elites, Cameras M07_CAM_07 & 08, and Laser Grids M07_T5_01 & M07_T5_02).

zones.name: West Perimeter Gatehouse
zones.description: Western security checkpoint overlooking the escape route down to Pier A (60, 40).

primary.title: Infiltrate the 3-story Administration Building and steal the shipping manifest from the top-floor vault at (410, 470)

secondary.title: Plant tracker on patrol boat at (90, 30) and escape unseen (Ghost Medal)

extraction.title: Extract at West Dock Extraction Point (60, 40)

events.description: At elapsed >= 720s, rain intensifies into a heavy downpour, reducing enemy hearing radius to 0.8x.
Every 90s (loop:90s), the Zone C gantry crane floodlight sweeps across the container yard unless sabotaged via S1 at (700, 150).

silent.name: Silent Route (Zone C Shadow Gap, Exterior Drainpipe/Vent to Floor 3, Ceiling Vent Laser Bypass & Boat Tracker)
silent.description: Sneak from (800, 10) through the Zone C shadow gap (720, 260), climb the exterior drainpipe/vent shaft at (500, 470) directly to Floor 3, bypass T5 laser grids via ceiling vent M07_VENT_SHAFT_ADMIN_D to steal the Shipping Manifest at (410, 470), descend to Pier Berth (90, 30) to plant the GPS tracker on the patrol boat (S2), and extract unseen at (60, 40).

technical.name: Technical Route (Sabotage Crane Controls S1, Hack T13 Rear Door, Disable Floor 2 Monitor & EMP T5 Lasers)
technical.description: Advance from (800, 10) to the Zone C Crane Control Booth at (700, 150) to sabotage the sweeping floodlight (S1), hack the rear T13 Alarmed Door at (400, 520), disable all 8 cameras at M07_MON_01 on Floor 2 and EMP the T5 Laser Grids to steal the manifest at (410, 470), exit via the West courtyard (200, 380), and extract at (60, 40).

loud.name: Loud Route (Counter-Snipe Crane Sniper E6, Breach Front Lobby, Clear Floor 3 E4 Elites & Fight to West Pier)
loud.description: Advance from (800, 10) to overwatch at (650, 150) to counter-snipe Gantry Crane Sniper M07_E6_01, breach the Administration Building front lobby at (400, 380), clear the 4x E4 Elites on Floor 3 to seize the manifest at (410, 470), exit West at (300, 470), and fight down to West Dock Extraction at (60, 40).

structures.description: Floor 3 ceiling vent shaft allowing silent bypass over T5 laser grids into Vault at (410, 470).
Towering Gantry Crane at (700, 150) with rotating floodlight sweeping the container yard every 90s.
Gantry Crane upper catwalk perch supporting Sniper M07_E6_01 at (700, 150, 12.0).
Enemy Patrol Boat moored at Pier Berth (90, 30) — Secondary Objective S2 (plant tracker on hull).
Crane Control Booth at (700, 150) — Secondary Objective S1 (sabotage crane controls to stop sweeping floodlight).
